title: Claude Code Subagents: Keep Your Context Clean
description:
Big searches flooding your AI chat? Send a subagent instead. 🧹

✅ A subagent works in its own context
✅ Save it as a file in .claude/agents with a name and read-only tools
✅ Only its short summary comes back to your chat

Day 10 of Token Saver, the last one! Next up: the new series Safe AI Agents, Day 1: Set Allow and Deny Permission Rules.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to spend fewer tokens with AI.

#shorts #claudecode #aicoding #aiagents #ai #programming #coding #learntocode
comment: Subagents or Compact: which would you use first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: give a subagent only the tools it needs, like Read, Grep and Glob, so it can search but not change your files.
